complete_examples.text: The yield line theory assumes that the floor slab is divided into several rigid plates by the yield line in the limit state, and that the plates conform to the deformation compatibility principle (Fig. 4).
Therefore, after calculating the axial tension force, the deformation compatibility relationship is adopted to estimate the bending moment [36,37].
